API ReferenceZscaler Digital Experience APIReportsGets the Call Quality metric trend for a device for a CQM application
Gets the Call Quality metric trend for a device for a CQM application
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zdx/v1/devices/:deviceid/apps/:appid/call-quality-metrics

Gets the Call Quality metric trend for a device for a CQM application. If the time range is not specified, the endpoint defaults to the last 2 hours.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
deviceid
integer
REQUIRED

The device ID.

appid
integer
REQUIRED

The application ID assigned by ZDX. For example, 12 for Microsoft Teams Call Quality.

Example: 12
QUERY PARAMETERS
from
integer

Possible values: >= 0

The start time (in seconds) for the query. The value is entered in Unix Epoch. If not entered, returns the data for the last 2 hours.

to
integer

Possible values: >= 0

The end time (in seconds) for the query. The value is entered in Unix Epoch. If not entered, returns the data for the last 2 hours.

Responses
​
200
401
403

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
meet_id
string

The meeting ID.

meet_session_id
string

The meeting session ID.

meet_subject
string

The subject of the meeting.

metrics
object[]
]
